x: He captains my team versus "The Rest of the World" in "The Grub Stakes." My vice-captain would be Mick Walker (who tends to overtrain) and the team completed by the inclusion of Cecil Penny (ranking equal 2, and on his day equal to two); and Big Ben May, who will improve as he grows.

Ring, the Ruthless, gave a great exhibition of Eastern passion in contrast to his partner, Cecil Penny, who danced with utter abandon. La Josephine, and our friend Ali, put in some fine work, although I am inclined to think the scales were faked when they weighed in!
Marshall Williams found an injured foot a handicap, and Cecil Penny, just after the start, injured one of his legs and seemed to be running with difficulty.
